subject: Request: on-call capacity exception — Senior SRE backfill
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: on-call capacity exception — Senior SRE backfill

Team,

I'd like to request an exception to the hiring freeze to immediately backfill a Senior SRE (individual contributor) on Platform Team A. We lost an experienced engineer last week (resignation effective May 8), and the team is now down to two primary on-call rotations for a service that is entering a six-week reliability push tied to the next customer milestone.

Why this is urgent: 
- Single point of failure: two people covering 24/7 (including weekend rotations) is below our internal safety threshold; mean time to recovery (MTTR) projection shows a 2x degradation if we don't add headcount.
- Domain knowledge: the departing engineer owned night-runbook automation and the KV cache eviction tuning that recently stabilized tail latency. Rebuilding that expertise will take months.
- Business risk: the product milestone on June 22 includes a high-visibility rollout for three mid-market customers; increased incident risk will likely trigger credits/penalties under contract.

Proposed mitigation and tradeoffs if approved: 
1) Hire a direct replacement Senior SRE (backfill) — 30% of the usual timeline with an expedited interview loop (internal referrals first).
2) Defer one open mid-stage IC hiring req (Data Eng) for this quarter; headcount tradeoff is feasible within org plan.
3) Short-term contractor coverage for after-hours (up to 8 weeks) — funded by pausing an external tooling pilot.

Attachments: a two-page impact analysis and the updated org snapshot (see attachments). I've included a link to the full analysis on Confluence as well.

Asking: formal authorization for a freeze exception and an expedited requisition approval (I can draft the JDX this afternoon). If we don't get approval by EOD Thursday (5/14) we will need to rearrange feature testing windows to avoid a risky production cut.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: oncall-impact-analysis.pdf, org-chart-May2026.png

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: on-call capacity exception — Senior SRE backfill

Laura —

Thanks for the clear write-up. A few quick items we need to process the exception: 
- Formal business justification (1 page) that maps risk to cost (e.g., projected credits, engineering hours, customer impact).
- Confirmation of the exact headcount delta (which role is being deferred) and org owner sign-off (Markus please confirm).
- Evidence you've explored internal mobility candidates and an offer timeline (we prefer internal moves where possible).

If you can attach the one-pager and the proposed JDX, I'll route to Finance and Execs for a fast review. If this is truly urgent, we can use the expedited hiring path; I just need the paperwork.

- Neha

Subject: Re: Request: on-call capacity exception — Senior SRE backfill

Neha / Markus —

Attached is the 1-page justification (pdf) and an updated org snapshot. Key excerpts from the analysis: 
- Estimated downgrade in MTTR: 1.9x without replacement; translates to ~18 extra engineering hours per major incident.
- Revenue exposure: three customers in the June rollout represent ~$420k ARR in net-new bookings; contract terms include uptime SLAs with potential credits capped at 5% of MRR for first-month incidents.
- Cost tradeoff: delaying the Data Eng hire frees a committed HC slot and preserves our contractor runway.

Internal mobility: two engineers in adjacent Platform pods have signaled interest; however, neither has the production debugging traces expertise required for the next six weeks without heavy shadowing. So internal split is feasible only as a stop-gap.

Proposed timeline: 
- 5/12: Exec exception request filed (this thread)
- 5/14: Finance/Exec approval target
- 5/17: Requisition posted internally
- 6/07: Offer extended (expedited loop)
- 6/14: Onboard (shadowing overlapped)

I can draft the JDX and the requisition now; attaching both.

Laura Bennett
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: oncall-impact-analysis.pdf, org-chart-May2026.png

Markus / Neha —

Finance has reviewed the impact analysis and the proposed tradeoff (deferring the Data Eng hire). We are prepared to provide conditional budget approval for a backfill under these conditions: 
1) Approval is limited to a Senior IC at the posted band; any above-band offers require additional Exec sign-off.
2) The Data Eng req must be paused in the headcount tracker within 24 hours of offer acceptance.
3) We will fund the short-term contractor coverage from the paused tooling pilot; provide cost estimates for the contractor plan.

Please complete the DocuSign exception form here: https://app.docusign.com/templates/EXCEPTION-REQ-8891. Once signed, Talent Ops will post the expedited requisition and the recruiter (Tara Simmons - cc'd earlier) will begin outreach.

If you need a faster turnaround, reply with "approve-now" and attach the signed JDX.

- Finance Approvals
